actors.name: Academic Senate
actors.private_context: The Academic Senate is the governing body of Ashvale University responsible for academic policy. It consists of faculty representatives, administrators, and possibly student representatives. The members have varying opinions on the pass-fail grading motion, but their individual positions are not predetermined. The Senate operates under standard parliamentary procedures for debate and voting.

shared_context: Ashvale University's Academic Senate will hold its October plenary meeting on a date within October 2026. A motion to adopt pass-fail grading for certain courses is on the agenda. The Senate can vote to pass the motion, reject it, or send it back to committee for further review. The meeting is scheduled to occur before the hard cutoff of 2026-10-30T18:00:00-05:00.

starting_events.description: The Academic Senate's October plenary meeting has not yet occurred. The pass-fail grading motion is on the agenda for that meeting.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Academic Senate voted to pass the motion at its October plenary before 2026-10-30T18:00:00-05:00. Resolve NO if the Senate voted to reject the motion or sent it back to committee, or if no final decision was reached by the cutoff. The specific outcome (reject vs. send back) is not distinguished in this resolution; only whether the motion passed or not.
